models.name: CIFAR cats 32×32 · NAND-only (best)
models.description: Best grayscale: 1,547 NAND gates after exact simplification (2,688 trained), 128-bit key, 8x compression, test BER 17.27%.

models.name: CIFAR cats 32×32 · Sobel edges (line drawings)
models.description: Edge binarization keeps the strongest 15% of Sobel gradients, so the target is a line drawing and stays legible at 32×32. 2,246 NAND gates, 128-bit key, test BER 30.78%. Negative result: the trainer cannot fit strokes this thin — the best validation epoch is the random initialisation, and edge F1@1.5 is 0.574 against 0.564 for random ink — so the reconstruction is noise even though the input reads as a cat.

models.name: CIFAR cats 32×32 · 4-level grey (2,048 bits)
models.description: Four-colour palette, two bit planes per pixel, 256-bit key, 2,695 gates. The targets are recognisable cats and the input panel shows them, but the reconstruction is still unstructured: abs MAE 21.0%, index accuracy 52.2%, BER 28.9% after 1,000 epochs.

models.name: CIFAR cats 16×16 · RGB 2-bit/channel (64 colours)
models.description: 2-bit colour: 6 bit planes, 1,536 bits, 192-bit key, 8x compression. 2,345 NAND gates after exact simplification; abs MAE 23.61% vs the original image.

models.name: CIFAR cats 16×16 · RGB 1-bit/channel
models.description: Color experiment: 8-colour RGB posterization, 128-bit key, 577 active gates; abs MAE 33.41% vs the original image.

models.name: CIFAR cats 16×16 · XOR + AND (threshold)
models.description: Grayscale control: threshold binarization, 32-bit key, test BER 22.85%.

models.name: Toy 8×8 · strict XOR
models.description: 16 patterns from a 4-dimensional GF(2) subspace; exact reconstruction.

models.name: MNIST digits 32×32 · NAND-only
models.description: Binarized MNIST, 128-bit key, 1,287 gates after exact simplification. Source of the keys used by the draw-a-digit tab.
